artworks.label: Felt matcha dango
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for matcha-mews. One small wooden dango skewer carrying three plump soft-felt mochi balls in matcha green, warm ivory and pale strawberry pink, tiny cocoa embroidered eyes on the center mochi, tied with a little sage linen bow, resting on a tiny scalloped ivory saucer. Kawaii handmade felt miniature, fine fuzzy wool texture and stitched seams, soft warm craft photography, matcha/cream/blush palette. No cat, fish, teacup, whisk, fern or beverage. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
